_readme: Every piece of text, every number, every link on the site comes from here. Nothing else needs touching. You can edit all of it without opening this file: sign in at the editor URL (kept in the CMS_PATH environment variable) and click any text or picture on the live site. Pictures can also be replaced by dropping a new file in /public/images and pointing the path here at it. After editing run `npm run dev` to preview, or push to deploy.

meta.title: Strategic Operations & GTM
meta.description: I turn ambiguity into traction — GTM strategy, operations and partnerships.

cases.title: 16 Months. 4 Borders. Zero Margin for Error.
cases.detail: When a government collapse cut off every standard channel out of the country overnight — no embassies, no banking access, no precedent — I built an independent evacuation operation from zero. I assembled a coalition across Harvard and UBC networks, retained immigration lawyers across four countries, and negotiated directly with border and immigration officials through constantly shifting policy, rerouting in real time whenever a path closed. The operation succeeded with $60,000 raised and zero margin for error. The experience later led to a keynote at Harvard on leadership in crisis.

cases.title: 4 Months. Zero Pipeline. First Place.
cases.detail: Built a go-to-market strategy from scratch for a new B2B SaaS product. Within four months, established a predictable lead generation engine, secured the first 10 enterprise customers, and won 'Best New Product' at a major industry conference.

cases.title: 1 Rebrand. 1 Roadmap. Market Visibility Restored.
cases.detail: Directed the comprehensive rebranding and repositioning of a legacy tech firm. Developed a clear, actionable 12-month marketing roadmap that re-engaged lost accounts and increased inbound qualified leads by 45%.

cases.title: 150+ Interviews. 10+ Investor Pitches. One Validated Strategy.
cases.detail: Conducted extensive customer discovery to pivot a struggling startup's core offering. The resulting data-backed strategy secured $60K in non-dilutive grant funding and successfully closed an early-stage seed round.

meta.title: Work
meta.description: Selected work in GTM strategy, crisis operations and partnerships.

hero.headline: I turn ambiguity into traction through persistence, work, and partnerships.
body: Operating in environments with high uncertainty requires a specific mindset: the ability to process complex variables, identify the critical path, and execute without waiting for perfect information.

Whether it's structuring a 0-to-1 go-to-market plan, leading cross-functional teams under pressure, or securing vital early-stage capital, my focus is always on building the system that makes the outcome repeatable.
